family_reports.body: The family court process moves at the speed of procedure, but childhood moves at the speed of time. While hearings, appeals, and delays continue, my son and I are the ones paying the price—through distance, missed moments, impeded communication, and a relationship that requires thousands of miles and thousands of dollars just to preserve. I have spent over six years being a stay at home mother and over $18,000 fighting simply to remain in his life after the judge awarded primary custody to the father last year.
